faqs.question: What's the dress code?
faqs.answer: Tropical formal. Think linen, Hawaiian shirts optional, barefoot is welcome. More island chic than black tie.

faqs.question: Will there be transportation?
faqs.answer: Free parking on-site. Details about any shuttle service will be included in your welcome packet.

faqs.question: Can I bring a plus-one?
faqs.answer: Invitations are personalized. Check your invite to see your +1 status. If you have questions, please reach out!

faqs.question: What time should I arrive?
faqs.answer: Arrive by 3:30 PM for cocktails. The ceremony begins promptly at 4:00 PM.

faqs.question: Is the venue beachside?
faqs.answer: Yes! We've chosen a stunning beachfront location. Bring your sunscreen and prepare for stunning views.

faqs.question: What if it rains?
faqs.answer: Aloha weather is unpredictable. We have covered areas and backup plans. Mahalo for your flexibility!
